title: Oil Swings Fade as Rising Yields Weigh on Equity Outlook | Investing.com
summary: Oil prices found support around its 20-day moving average amidst market confusion, with the December 2027 oil futures contract trading higher than its peak in February 2022, suggesting a new structural premium. Meanwhile, the tech-heavy Nasdaq and the Dow Jones Industrial Average showed weakness independent of oil prices, with the Nasdaq breaking out higher after a long downtrend.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses negative market trends such as the weakness in tech stocks and the potential for a long-term structural premium in oil prices, but also notes a breakout in the Nasdaq, which indicates mixed market sentiment.
